verdict.rationale: Importing mail history and contacts is a fair question for an email provider, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no migration or import tool for messages or contacts. The IMAP/SMTP support lets external clients connect to an AgentMail inbox, but that is an adjacent feature, and using it to move mail would be a user-side workaround rather than a documented import capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
